annotations.title: How many BTC venues list each token

description: For a swap where native BTC is the source: how many BTC venues list each of ravn_tokens's tokens on `chainId`. A ranking hint (a token more venues list is more likely to keep routing through one venue's outage), not a gate: ravn_quote decides, and tokens off RAVN's list route from BTC too. BTC-as-source only.

apiKey.description: Your RAVN API key, if you have one — raises your rate limit

chainId.description: The destination chain to check BTC-source coverage on

name: ravn_btc_coverage

coverage.description: Token address (lowercase on EVM; a Solana mint exactly as listed, since base58 is case-sensitive) to the number of BTC venues (1-3) that list it, for native Bitcoin as the source. Every RAVN-listed token on the chain is in it

filtered.description: False means the upstream venue lists couldn't be reached right now — coverage is empty and the answer is unknown, not 'nothing routes'. Treat like an outage: don't filter your token list on it

title: How many BTC venues list each token
